Repair the buggy source below without changing the required API.

File contract: Write solution.rs with the public function at module scope; use only the standard library.
Required API: pub fn compact_ordered_events(seq: &[i32], keys: &[String], values: &[i32]) -> Option<Vec<i32>>
Behavior: The three arrays encode events with strictly increasing sequence numbers. Reject unequal lengths, non-increasing sequence numbers, or empty keys. Keep only the final event for each key and return its value, ordered by the final events' positions; empty input succeeds.
Visible example: seq [1,2,3,8], keys [a,b,a,c], values [4,7,9,2] return [7,9,2].

Buggy source to repair:

use std::collections::HashSet;pub fn compact_ordered_events(seq:&[i32],keys:&[String],values:&[i32])->Option<Vec<i32>>{if seq.len()!=keys.len()||seq.len()!=values.len(){return None}let mut seen=HashSet::new();Some((0..values.len()).filter(|&i|seen.insert(&keys[i])).map(|i|values[i]).collect())}

reference.code: use std::collections::HashMap;pub fn compact_ordered_events(seq:&[i32],keys:&[String],values:&[i32])->Option<Vec<i32>>{if seq.len()!=keys.len()||seq.len()!=values.len(){return None}let mut last=HashMap::new();for i in 0..seq.len(){if i>0&&seq[i]<=seq[i-1]||keys[i].is_empty(){return None}last.insert(&keys[i],i);}Some((0..values.len()).filter(|&i|last[&keys[i]]==i).map(|i|values[i]).collect())}
